meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: Claude 会按你的文字描述生成新图片，或根据参考图修改图片，并把结果保存为 PNG 文件。使用前需要配置 OpenRouter API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你要生成照片、插画、概念图等通用视觉图片，或要求基于参考图编辑/合成图片时触发。技术图表请用另一个技能。

say.text: 帮我生成一张海边日落的照片
say.note: 生成新图并保存为 PNG

say.text: 把这张照片的背景改成蓝色
say.note: 需提供图片路径，会编辑原图

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Pro 画一幅太空主题插画

howto.what_en: Claude will generate new images from your text description or edit images based on a reference image, then save the result as a PNG file. Requires an OpenRouter API key.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for photos, illustrations, concept art, or similar general images, or request editing/compositing from a reference image. Technical diagrams are covered by the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Create a photo of a sunset by the sea
say_en.note: Generates a new image and saves it as PNG

say_en.text: Change this photo's background to blue
say_en.note: Provide the image path; edits the original

say_en.text: Draw a space-themed illustration using FLUX.2 Pro
